links.note: What the चिड़िया stands for -- पक्षियों का: the bird of the पीपल की डाली whose गान is the whole कविता, 30267. 30274 loses because it covers the birds' address to मानव, not who the singer stands for.
Who works दिन भर -- the पक्षी; the कविता sets their day-labour against संचय, which is 30276. 30273 covers the मिल-जुलकर living and eating lines of that same stanza, not the working.
शुक = तोता, from the roster खंजन, कपोत, चातक, कोकिल, काक, हंस, शुक that 30273's line shows living हिलमिल. 30284 covers the आसमान as their घर, not the roll of names.
कपोत = कबूतर, from the same वन-में-पंछी roster of 30273. 30267 covers the single चिड़िया of the पीपल की डाली, not the flock.

What she tells the बंदी मानव -- मुक्ति-मंत्र. 30284 is the concept holding स्वच्छंद विचरण against मनुष्य के बंधन. 30268 covers that she carries a संदेश at all, not that its content is release from fetters.
Who sings on the पीपल की ऊँची डाली -- the चिड़िया; 30267's opening scene. 30274 covers the पक्षी speaking to मानव, not this image.
Who teaches प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति -- the चिड़िया; 30272 is that first संदेश. 30268 covers the संदेश being in her own बोली, not its content.

सोने की कड़ियाँ glossed as लालच-बंधन -- the fetters मानव is told to break, which 30284 holds as the counterpart of स्वच्छंद विचरण. 30276 covers the birds' own freedom from लोभ, not the human's golden chains.
The भावना to be given up is द्रोह-भावना, the negative of the प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति 30272 names as the bird's teaching. 30274 covers the सीखो-तुम-हमसे address; here one specific भावना is keyed.
What she conveys in her बोली -- a संदेश of प्रेम and एकता; 30268 is the संदेश-in-her-own-बोली concept. 30272 covers the प्रेम-प्रीति teaching itself, but the item keys the बोली carrying a संदेश.
Which रीति she teaches -- प्रेम-प्रीति की; 30272 verbatim. 30273 covers the मिल-जुलकर equality lines, not the रीति.
मुक्ति-मंत्र for the जग के बंदी मानव -- the बंधन-versus-स्वच्छंद-विचरण pairing of 30284. 30268 covers only that she brings a संदेश.
Which पक्षी live हिलमिल in the वन -- 30273's सब आपस में हिलमिल line. 30284 covers the open आसमान as their घर, not the shared वन.
Their घर is the आसमान -- आसमान ही उनका घर है, the नभीय विचरण of 30284. 30273 covers their living together, not the sky as home.
What their मन lacks -- लोभ, पाप, परवाह: 30276's no-संचय concept. 30272 covers the प्रेम-प्रीति teaching, not the absence of लोभ.
How they fill their पेट -- only what their own श्रम yields; 30276. 30273 covers मिल-जुलकर खाना, not the limit on what is taken.
The options set स्वच्छंद होकर जीना against धन संग्रह, exactly the choice 30275 asks students to settle. 30274 carries the सीखो-तुम-हमसे address without that either/or.
The चिड़िया as प्रतीक of स्वतंत्रता, सहजता and प्रेम -- the bundle of मूल भाव 30271 lists. 30267 covers the literal bird on the डाली, not what she symbolises.
जग के बंदी मानव = man bound in मोह-माया: the मनुष्य-के-बंधन half of 30284. 30275 covers what kind of जीवन the कविता urges, not the gloss of this phrase.
The मुख्य संदेश chosen against धन का संचय -- सरल, संतोषी, बंधनमुक्त जीवन: 30275's own स्वच्छंद-or-संचय decision. 30271 lists the कविता's भाव but does not stage that choice.
Blank is द्रोह-भावना, the भावना set against the प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति of 30272. 30274 covers the सीखो-तुम-हमसे address of the same stanza, not this word.
Blank is सीमा-हीन -- the boundless गगन they range निर्भय, 30284's नभीय विचरण. 30276 covers freedom from लोभ, not from boundaries.
Blank is प्रेम-प्रीति in चिड़िया बैठी ___ की रीति हमें सिखलाती है -- 30272's own line. 30268 covers the बोली carrying a संदेश.
Blank is चाह -- no wish to हड़पना the जग का सारा माल: 30276's no-संचय line. 30270 covers the surplus left औरों के हित, which is the following thought.
Blank is पेड़ों -- दिन भर काम, then sleep on a पेड़ at night: the unaccumulating routine 30276 names. 30284 covers the आसमान as घर, not the night's roost.
Blank is सुनाने -- she comes to the पीपल की डाली to convey just this संदेश, 30268. 30267 covers where she sits, not what she comes for.
Blank is ऊँची -- the पीपल की ऊँची डाली of 30267's opening scene. 30268 covers the संदेश, not the perch.
Blank is मानव in वे कहते हैं, ___ ! सीखो तुम हमसे जीना जग में -- 30274's केंद्रीय संबोधन. 30275 covers which kind of जीवन is urged, not the vocative.
What she means by मानवता से द्रोह-भावना को छोड़ो -- the enmity to be dropped in favour of the प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति of 30272. 30274 covers the सीखो address in the same stanza.
Where she is sitting -- पीपल की ऊँची डाली पर, 30267. 30284 covers where the पक्षी fly, not where she perches.
Their जीवन is सरल, निःस्वार्थ, संतोषी -- the contentment side of 30276's no-संचय. 30273 covers their living together; the answer keys संतोष.
द्रोह-भावना glossed as शत्रुता का भाव -- the opposite of the प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति 30272 names. 30270 covers the कवि's करुणा and त्याग in general, not this word in the कविता.
मुक्ति-मंत्र glossed as living स्वतंत्रतापूर्वक -- the release from बंधन 30284 sets against the birds' free flight. 30275 covers which जीवन to choose, not this gloss.
Who wrote the कविता -- आरसी प्रसाद सिंह; 30269 is the only concept about the कवि himself. 30270 covers the themes of his रचनाएँ, not his name.
Which पक्षी the कविता names -- the वन roster of 30273's हिलमिल line. 30284 covers the आसमान, not the list.
What a चिड़िया is -- the small bird that flies; the कविता's title figure of 30267. 30273 covers the flock of named वन पक्षी, not the चिड़िया herself.
प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति glossed as the way of प्रेम and सौहार्द -- 30272 exactly. 30273 covers the समानता-और-एकता lines, a different भाव.
What the absence of लोभ and पाप shows -- सादगी and स्वतंत्रता; 30276's greed-renouncing concept. 30284 covers the sky-freedom, not the absence of लोभ.
The संदेश enumerated as प्रेम, एकता, निःस्वार्थता, स्वतंत्रता -- the four मूल भाव 30271 lists. 30268 covers that the बोली carries a संदेश; here the भाव themselves are keyed.
What the birds' जीवन teaches us -- 30274's सीखो तुम हमसे जीना जग में. 30275 stages the स्वच्छंद-or-संचय choice; this item asks for the सीख.
Whom जग के बंदी मानव addresses and why -- man caught in his own बंधन, 30284's contrast. 30274 covers the address urging him to learn, not the description of his captivity.
The कविता का मुख्य भाव -- 30271 is the मूल भाव concept by name. 30275 covers the kind of जीवन recommended, a narrower question.
Why मनुष्य is told to break the बेड़ी on his पाँव -- बंधन against स्वच्छंद विचरण, 30284. 30276 covers the birds' freedom from लोभ, not man's shackles.
How the पक्षी behave परस्पर -- प्रेमपूर्ण, सहयोगी, मिल-जुलकर: the समानता और एकता of 30273. 30272 covers the रीति the चिड़िया teaches मानव, not the birds' mutual conduct.
What their दिन भर काम means -- constant effort for their own दाना-पानी; 30276's श्रम-without-संचय. 30273 covers मिल-जुलकर खाना.
Their आत्मनिर्भरता -- own भोजन, own घोंसला: the श्रम side of 30276. 30284 covers their range in the गगन, not their self-sufficiency.
उनके मन में लोभ नहीं है explained -- no greed for धन-दौलत; 30276 verbatim. 30270 covers what is left औरों के हित, the following line.
सीमा-हीन गगन में उड़ते, निर्भय विचरण teaches us to break needless बंधन -- 30284's नभीय विचरण against मनुष्य के बंधन. 30275 covers the choice of जीवन without the gagan image.
What the चिड़िया says in the प्रेम-प्रीति line -- the way of प्रेम and सौहार्द, 30272. 30268 covers her बोली carrying a संदेश.
जग का सारा माल हड़पकर जाने की भी चाह नहीं explained as संतोष -- 30276's no-संचय. 30270 covers the giving away of what is left over.
पाप नहीं परवाह नहीं explained -- no wrongdoing, no चिंता: part of 30276's लोभ/पाप/परवाह line. 30284 covers निर्भय flight, not this moral freedom.

सब मिल-जुलकर रहते हैं वे, सब मिल-जुलकर खाते हैं explained as समानता और एकता -- 30273's own reading of that पंक्ति. 30281 is the multiple-choice drill that makes students pick that भाव against distractors; here the भाव is asked outright.
What the कवि makes of her गाना -- a संदेश in her बोली that he tries to read; 30268's क्या तुम उसे समझते हो. 30267 covers the scene of her singing, not the संदेश behind it.
The birds' विशेषताएँ as the कविता lists them -- मिल-जुलकर, आसमान घर, दिन भर काम, no लोभ, निर्भय उड़ान: the whole भाव set of 30271. 30276 covers only the लोभ-and-श्रम strand of that list.
सोने की कड़ियाँ तोड़ो as a call to break भौतिक बंधन -- 30284's मनुष्य-के-बंधन counterpart to स्वच्छंद विचरण. 30276 covers the birds' own freedom from लोभ.
How her व्यवहार can inspire मानव -- 30274's सीखो तुम हमसे जीना. 30271 lists the कविता's भाव; this item asks what मानव takes from her.
The दृष्टिकोण to hold towards प्रकृति and प्राणी -- करुणा and सह-अस्तित्व: 30270 is the करुणा-and-shared-सुंदर-संसार concept. 30269 covers the कवि as a depicter of प्रकृति, not the reader's duty.
Why मनुष्य is called बेड़ी पग में -- bound by सांसारिक बंधन while the पक्षी range free: 30284's comparison. 30275 covers what जीवन to choose instead.
Why the पक्षी compare themselves with मानव -- to press the address सीखो तुम हमसे जीना, 30274. 30284 covers the स्वच्छंदता-versus-बेड़ी content of that comparison; this item asks why they make it.
